full_prompt_en: A square flat-color television cartoon frame shows four figures standing side by side in a mint-green living room. The pale cream ceiling and tan tiled floor form simple horizontal bands above and below the wall. At the far left, a dark-skinned man with short black hair and a narrow mustache wears a burgundy collared shirt, tan trousers, and brown shoes; his arms hang beside him. Next stands a brown dog with an upright human-like body, dressed in a navy suit, white shirt, and tie. The dog's muzzle projects to the right, and its round eyes look ahead above the jacket lapels. In the center, a broad man with short brown hair, round glasses, a white short-sleeved shirt, green trousers, and black shoes faces slightly right with one arm extended. At the far right, a red-haired woman in a pale blouse and blue trousers stands with one hand on her hip, looking toward the center. Behind the group, a framed window reveals a pale blue exterior and simple roof shapes; a door opens at the right edge. A small wall ornament and low furniture appear at the left, while a reddish rug lies under the figures' feet. The lighting is even and shadowless apart from compact dark contact shapes beneath shoes. Strong dark outlines keep faces and clothing legible over broad matte fills, with little surface texture or depth modeling. The overall composition is a balanced frontal group, using warm character colors against a cool room for a light, conversational mood.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形、平涂色彩的电视动画画面呈现四名人物并排站在薄荷绿色客厅里。浅乳白天花板和棕褐色瓷砖地面在墙的上方与下方形成简单横带。最左侧是一名深肤色、短黑发、留窄胡子的男子，穿酒红色有领上衣、浅棕长裤和棕鞋，双臂垂在身旁。旁边是一只直立、具有人形身体的棕色狗，穿海军蓝西装、白衬衫和领带。它的口鼻向右突出，圆眼从外套翻领上方望向前方。中央是一名身形宽大的男子，留短棕发、戴圆眼镜，穿白色短袖衬衫、绿长裤和黑鞋，身体稍向右，伸出一只手臂。最右侧红发女子穿浅色衬衣与蓝长裤，一只手叉腰，望向中央。人群背后，一个带框窗户露出浅蓝色室外和简单的屋顶形状；右缘有一扇门敞开。左边有小壁饰和低矮家具，人物脚下铺着偏红的地毯。光线均匀，除鞋底紧凑的深色接触阴影外几乎没有阴影。强而深的轮廓线让脸与衣服在宽阔哑光平涂色块上清楚可读，表面肌理与纵深塑形很少。整体构图是均衡的正面群像，以温暖人物色彩对照冷调房间，形成轻松的交谈气氛。
style_prompt_en: Flat television-cartoon drawing relies on bold uniform outlines, simple rounded anatomy, and broad matte color fills. Warm coral, brown, burgundy, and olive are placed against pale mint, cream, and tan backgrounds. Faces use a few clean marks for eyes, brows, and mouths, keeping expressions readable at small scale. Depth comes from overlaps, a handful of room planes, and compact ground-contact shapes rather than gradient shading. Repeated upright silhouettes align along a clear horizontal base, while a sparse domestic backdrop supplies context without competing for attention. Light is even and neutral, allowing color separation to do most of the visual work. The overall effect is friendly, direct, and neatly staged.
style_prompt_zh: 平涂电视卡通依靠粗细统一的深色外轮廓、简化而圆润的解剖形体和宽阔哑光色面。暖珊瑚、棕、酒红与橄榄色放在浅薄荷绿、乳白和棕褐色背景前。面部仅用少数干净笔痕表现眼、眉和嘴，使表情在小尺度下仍可读。纵深来自遮叠、少量室内平面和紧凑的地面接触色块，而非渐变阴影。重复的直立剪影沿清楚的水平基线排列，稀疏的居家背景提供情境，却不争夺注意力。光线均匀中性，使色彩分隔承担大部分视觉作用。整体效果亲切、直接，布置整齐。
theme_en: Four cartoon figures standing in a mint-green living room
theme_zh: 四名卡通人物站在薄荷绿色客厅里
name: Family Guy
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
